continuity: Jin Taekyung destroyed the three incomplete Liches who commanded the undead army, causing the monster army to collapse.
The three incomplete Liches identified themselves as servants of an Arch Lich that first appeared one week earlier and swore that their account was true on the River of Death.
The Skeleton Warlord absorbed the three Liches' death energy, became substantially stronger, and remains stored in Jin Taekyung's Inventory under the mocking nickname Bones.
Jin Taekyung completed the Unexpected Attack Quest, acquired the Undead Hunter Title, gained EXP and Fame, and reached Level 121 after one level-up.
Wei Fenghu is the Minister of National Defense under China's Central Military Commission and a four-star general.
Wei Fenghu is taking Jin Taekyung to the operations headquarters, where a jet is waiting and unidentified people are expecting him.
plot: Jin Taekyung captures the three incomplete Liches commanding the undead army and interrogates them about the Arch Lich's week-long attack. After confirming their testimony through the Skeleton Warlord's oath on the River of Death, Jin rejects their attempted loyalty and destroys them, while the Skeleton Warlord devours their death energy and grows far stronger. Jin completes the Unexpected Attack Quest, gains the Undead Hunter Title, EXP, Fame, and one level, then meets Team Leader Choi, Shao Shen, and Wei Fenghu, who says that everyone is waiting for Jin at the operations headquarters.
translation_decisions: Preserve the Skeleton Warlord's bickering pet dynamic; render 골골 as Bones and retain Warlordmon when it uses its former name.
Keep Jin Taekyung's casual, dry, and profane voice, including the deliberate Lord Fuck gag when Shao Shen nearly says 시벌좌.
Render 웨이펑후 as Wei Fenghu and his title as Minister of National Defense under the Central Military Commission.
Render 사기 as death energy and 죽음의 강 as River of Death.
Retain Arch Lich, Undead Hunter, and Bayern as established terminology.

active_continuity: Jin Taekyung destroyed the three incomplete Liches serving the Arch Lich, collapsing the undead monster army at Chengdu International Airport.
The incomplete Liches swore on the River of Death that their account of the Arch Lich's actions was truthful.
The Skeleton Warlord absorbed a massive amount of death energy, grew much stronger, and is kept in Jin Taekyung's Inventory; Jin calls it Bones as a mocking pet name.
Jin Taekyung is Level 121 and has acquired the Undead Hunter Title after completing the Unexpected Attack Quest.
Team Leader Choi and Shao Shen survived the airport battle and met Jin after the fighting ended.
Wei Fenghu is China's Minister of National Defense under the Central Military Commission and a four-star general.
Wei Fenghu is taking Jin Taekyung to an operations headquarters where a jet and unidentified waiting people are present.
open_questions: Who is the Arch Lich, and what will happen after Jin Taekyung destroys its three servants?
Who is everyone waiting for Jin Taekyung at the operations headquarters?
What happened to the Second Fiend assigned to the Qingcheng attack?
Who is the unidentified person directing Aehyang, and what are they planning?
What is the true nature and purpose of the Lord of Heaven, and what became of the Western Heaven Demon Lord?
temporary_decisions: Render 열화신룡 as Blazing Flame Divine Dragon, distinct from Huashan Divine Dragon.
Use Mimi for 미미 and Mimi-chan for 미미쨩; render 삼괴 as Third Fiend in singular references and Three Fiends in collective references.
Render 진인 as Perfected One, 도우 as Fellow Daoist, 신니 as Venerable Nun, 환영진 as illusion formation, and 이동진 as Moving Formation.
Render 독룡각 as Poison Dragon Pavilion, 가주 대행 as Acting Family Head, 화룡갑 as Fire Dragon Armor, and 아크 리치 as Arch Lich.
Render 사기 as death energy, 의념 as conveyed thoughts, 데스나이트 as Death Knight, and 골골 as Bones.
